A private unknown-dispatch candidate retains original root/actor/Pause/takeover/capacity custody. One bounded pre-Observe collection retains exact unclaimed retirement or correlated terminal evidence in existing records, without accepting it as current, clearing unknown effects or granting Resume. Delayed I/O cannot admit late evidence; collection misses remain ambiguous. Ledger8 uses one closed 32768-byte typed EffectReconciliation envelope for delivery, lifecycle and owned exit. Write/reopen correlate basis semantics with independent original dispatch receipts, actor/root/Work/epoch, source IDs and collection clocks; old ledger/effect shapes reject. Framed late results consume original reserved capacity before diagnostic Observe. Explicit reconciliation needs current fresh paused evidence and does not rewrite the unknown ACK/charge. Separate normal-play recovery readmission charges one Resume; navigation retains its original goal/Work/root, first game anchor and cumulative limits. Pending continuation fences competing roots/handoff; unknown Resume and unsupported ownership stop. Historical or orphan proof restores no private consent.

controls.name: Design and independent change review

controls.mechanism: Lead owns design/integration and verifies returned evidence; at most two workers use separate project-local worktrees and named disjoint paths, with shared runtime serialized; fresh-context review assesses contracts, risk and maintainability before acceptance. Review new or expanded custom infrastructure across code/docs/workflow/controls against S-CODE: name the existing option, unmet gap, smallest scope, owner/cost and retirement trigger; reject unjustified duplication. Before publication, inspect explicit Git author/committer identities and all new commit messages, including co-author trailers, under S-WORK. Use repository-local Git identity configuration. Before merging a PR whose Issue completion awaits merged-main validation, read gh pr view --json closingIssuesReferences, require an empty list and re-read after removing references. Prose negation is not a parser control; use GitHub computed data, no custom keyword parser. For source-dependent consequential claims, inspect executable predicates, caller cadence, units and defaults against actual outcomes; preserve mistaken rationale and which actions preceded correction.
controls.trigger: significant change, new boundary/guarantee/dependency or integration checkpoint
controls.failure_response: Resolve material findings or record scoped owner/reason/revisit exception; after two unsuccessful worker repairs lead takes back the work.
controls.limitations: No code checker proves reasoning quality, typing completeness, decomposition or delegation compliance; independence depends on the actual review process. Reuse fit and the adequacy of its rationale are semantic judgments; CI does not prove them. Identity configuration prevents inferred defaults but does not inspect file contents or prove a message, branch or remote ref contains no personal information; full-message inspection remains manual.
controls.enforcement: Required by S-AGENT and the GitHub work/PR workflow; independent agent review is manually recorded, not an independent GitHub human approval. Hosted enforcement is recorded separately in acceptance.
